Company Overview
Delivering person-centric wellness and healthcare.
InPursuit Health is a digital healthcare and wellness company. We deliver personalized wellness and healthcare directly to consumers, and equip independent providers with digital care services they have never been able to offer their patients, all running on the InPursuit Orchestration Layer, our infrastructure that is already built and operating today.

How the bridge works
One infrastructure, built once, serving both.

The record and the AI are the foundation, an orchestration layer that runs any AI, not only our own, routing each person to the best model for their condition. Everything else is delivery. As each practice joins the InPursuit Partner Network, thousands of consumers gain access to the same infrastructure through the free InPursuit app, creating a self-reinforcing ecosystem that benefits both. The second capability costs a fraction of the first, and the fifteenth costs less.

Company Overview
One app. Many capabilities. This is one of them.
The InPursuit app is where a person's whole health life lives: their record, insurance, virtual visits, medications, care plan, and savings, all in one place. The screens on this page show a single capability inside it, InPursuit Reflect. We lead with it because it serves both engines at once: D2C members open it daily to track their vitals and health, and those same scans generate the ongoing monitoring data our provider members deliver as reimbursable care.

InPursuit Reflect
The bridge, in one gesture
50 sec

Face and finger scan, start to finish.

21

Vitals and wellness signals from a single scan.

7

FDA cleared determinations among them.

0

Cuffs, labs, wearables, or clinic visits required.

InPursuit Reflect is the biometric hub. Beyond its own face and finger scan, it ingests data from any connected wearable or device the member already owns, then writes it all back to the one record that powers the insights, the care plan, and the provider's billable monitoring. One hub, every signal, both engines fed from the same place.
